flags.why: The mechanical sense ‘jammed’ is ordinary usage, as in khóa hóc and súng hóc, rather than rare ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-h%C3%B3c)).
Biểu thị belongs to formal language, so leaving it untagged encourages unnatural casual usage.
Learners are most likely to encounter hát ru as the action of singing a lullaby.
The example defines the mythical bird instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Trên chiếc bình có hình một con phượng hoàng. = There is an image of a fenghuang on the vase.

flags.why: The entry omits the common verb meaning ‘to stamp or stomp’, as in dậm chân ([dictionary discussion](https://sachhay24h.com/danh-dam-hay-danh-giam-a4339.html)).
flags.fix: verb | to stamp; to stomp; ex: Nó tức giận dậm chân xuống đất. = He stamped his foot on the ground in anger.

flags.why: Mắt kính meaning a whole pair of glasses is mainly Southern usage, whereas the lens meaning is not regionally restricted.
flags.fix: Separate ‘lens (of glasses)’ without a region tag from ‘glasses’ with the Southern tag.
